name: Front foot drive
when: A full ball you can reach with a forward step.
steps: Watch the ball and step your front foot towards its line.
Bring the bat down straight, with your head over the ball.
Meet it under your eyes and finish balanced.
cue: Step, head over ball, straight bat.

name: Cover drive
when: A full ball outside off stump that you can reach.
steps: Step towards the pitch of the ball, along its line.
Keep your head over the ball and bring the bat down straight.
Guide it through the covers and hold a balanced finish.
cue: Reach the ball; head still; drive through covers.

name: Straight drive
when: A full ball close to the stumps.
steps: Step towards the ball with your front foot.
Keep the bat face straight and your head over contact.
Extend the bat back past the bowler and finish balanced.
cue: Straight bat, straight line.

name: On drive
when: A full ball on or just outside leg stump.
steps: Step towards the ball and stay balanced.
Bring a straight bat through its line.
Let the bat face send it towards mid on.
cue: Step into line; straight bat to mid on.

name: Defensive shot
when: A ball you choose to keep out rather than score from.
steps: Move your feet into the ball's line.
Keep your head close to the ball and the bat face straight.
Use soft hands so it drops near your feet.
cue: Get in line; soft hands; bat close to pad.

name: Pull shot
when: A short ball around waist to chest height, when its bounce is predictable.
steps: Move back and across to make room.
Watch the short ball and turn your body through it.
Swing the bat across the line and keep your balance.
cue: Back and across; eyes on ball; turn through.

name: Hook shot
when: A short ball rising around shoulder or head height.
steps: Judge the bounce first; duck or sway if it is not there to hit.
Move back and across, eyes on the ball.
Turn the bat across the ball while keeping your head in line.
cue: Read the bounce first; back and across; turn.

name: Square cut
when: A short, wide ball outside off stump.
steps: Move back and across to give your arms space.
Wait for the ball to come beside you.
Cut across it towards point, staying balanced.
cue: Back and across; wait; cut square.

name: Late cut
when: A short, wide ball outside off stump with room behind point.
steps: Move back and stay side on.
Let the ball pass close to your body.
Open the bat face late and steer it behind point.
cue: Wait late; open the face; steer.

name: Upper cut
when: A short, wide ball rising outside off stump.
steps: Move back and make room outside off stump.
Keep your eyes on the rising ball.
Lift the bat face through the ball behind point.
cue: Make room; watch the rise; lift behind point.

name: Sweep shot
when: A fuller ball from a spinner when you can get low safely.
steps: Take a long step and lower your body towards the ball.
Keep your head over the ball and watch it closely.
Swing the bat across the line while staying balanced.
cue: Get low; head over ball; sweep across.

name: Reverse sweep
when: A fuller spinning ball when you have decided early to send it to the opposite side.
steps: Practise the changed bat face slowly without a ball first.
Get low with your head over the ball.
Sweep towards the opposite side and finish balanced.
cue: Decide early; get low; change the bat face.

name: Slog sweep
when: A fuller spinning ball you choose to hit hard to the leg side.
steps: Plant your front foot and get low near the pitch of the ball.
Keep your head steady as the bat travels across.
Swing through the ball and finish high without falling away.
cue: Plant; stay low; swing through.

name: Paddle sweep
when: A fuller ball from a spinner that you can guide fine.
steps: Get low early and keep your head close to the ball.
Use a short, controlled bat path.
Guide the ball fine and hold your balance.
cue: Low early; short bat path; guide fine.

name: Flick shot
when: A ball on the pads or leg side.
steps: Get your front foot near the ball's line.
Keep your head steady as the bat comes through.
Turn the wrists gently to guide it into the leg side.
cue: Step in line; soft wrists to leg side.

name: Leg glance
when: A ball on the pads that you can guide fine on the leg side.
steps: Move into the ball's line without falling over.
Let it come close to your pads.
Use soft wrists to glance it fine and stay balanced.
cue: Get in line; soft wrists; guide fine.

name: Lofted drive
when: A full ball you can reach and choose to hit in the air.
steps: Step towards the pitch of the ball.
Keep your head still and swing through its line.
Extend the bat high and finish balanced.
cue: Reach it; swing through; balanced high finish.

name: Lofted offside
when: A full ball you can reach and choose to lift into the off side.
steps: Step towards the pitch and keep your head over the ball.
Swing the bat through the off-side line.
Extend high and finish balanced.
cue: Reach it; off-side line; high finish.

name: Lofted legside
when: A full ball you can reach and choose to lift into the leg side.
steps: Step towards the pitch without losing balance.
Swing through the leg-side line with your eyes on the ball.
Extend high and hold the finish.
cue: Step in line; leg-side swing; balanced finish.

name: Down the wicket
when: A spinner you choose to meet closer to the bounce.
steps: Decide early and move your feet towards the pitch of the ball.
Keep your head over the ball as you reach it.
Play with a straight bat and recover your balance.
cue: Move early; reach the pitch; stay balanced.

name: Scoop shot
when: A planned fine shot to a suitable full ball.
steps: Set up early and lower your body.
Watch the ball closely as it reaches you.
Use a controlled bat face to lift it fine.
cue: Set early; eyes on ball; controlled lift.

name: Leave
when: A ball safely outside your stumps that you do not need to play.
steps: Read the line early and keep your eyes on the ball.
Move the bat out of its path.
Stay balanced until the ball passes.
cue: Read line; lift bat away; stay balanced.

name: Switch hit
when: An advanced shot that changes your batting stance before contact.
steps: Practise the stance change slowly without a ball first.
Keep your head steady and eyes on the ball.
Complete the swing in balance before adding speed.
cue: Change stance early; watch ball; balance.
